title: Surreal Desert Portal
description: A circular portal framed by an intricate steampunk border of copper pipes, glass jars containing dried orange slices, buttons, feathers, and metal bowls. Through the portal is a surreal desert landscape at sunset with long shadows, silhouetted figures walking on sand dunes, a lone wooden door standing in the center, and floating mechanical airships in a purple and orange sky.
prompt: Surreal steampunk artwork featuring a large circular portal with an ornate border made of copper pipes, glass jars with dried citrus slices, metal bowls, buttons and feathers. Inside the portal is a vast desert at sunset with rippled sand dunes, several silhouetted human figures casting long dramatic shadows, a single wooden door standing alone in the center, distant mountains, and whimsical floating airships in a vibrant purple, pink and orange sky.
